title: Rust
description: Rust projects: the Rust toolchain (rustc, cargo, clippy) mounted in; crates.io, rustup's downloads and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Rust
de.description: Rust-Projekte: die Rust-Toolchain (rustc, cargo, clippy) eingehängt; crates.io, die Downloads von rustup und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The toolchain (rustc, cargo, rustfmt, clippy; it brings the C toolchain cc it links with, and zig) comes with the preset (--toolchain rust): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox). Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add rust: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.

Another Rust version (a rust-toolchain.toml, which the toolchain does not read: it has no rustup): rustup into the sandbox's HOME, kept with the start (curl https://sh.rustup.rs -sSf | sh -s -- -y; sh.rustup.rs and static.rust-lang.org are open), then PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH puts its cargo before the toolchain's.
A build needs memory: --memory 16g on the command line for a large workspace.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
